book.title: Jön Jöntho Fatmata ogepma irim togoc

content: Lasarus omboc
Oro Betani böcsa amna au mano Lasarus yu obukoc tongga idoc. Yuhon natnin yan dano Maria orin Marta yu ihorocgon böcsa wocin ididomoroc.
Maria yu wömai osuc unac tugoni Morömahon orungodec koringmuna inoin bigo sakemoho tong manman togoc.
Oro Lasarus obukoc tongga idina yan danomaho mata ingoroc siunya Yesuot onggoc: ‘Moröma, amna gocho yuha toup kombingitarocma yu obukoc tongga itac.”

Mata ihoroc siunya Yesuot onguna yu wo kombingo yogoc, “Obukoc worocho omomphon muno. Kopotorochon Mananoho wo tun bödeangoc. Tongo yu ma moröma sogiangoc. O Kopotorochon gesö morömaho owi amnaho yangamin eran öngkuuna ango Kopotoroc yong moröng imonahing.” Yesu yu ihoroc yogoc.
Yu wömai Maria Marta Lasarus yomot natni yuha toup sinom kombingidoc
mahong yu Lasarusho obukoc togocmahon fatno kombingga karupgon yuot manggoc. Muno yu sep youp toctoc yai sa idocan wocegon torengga idoc.
Sep yai bödeuna Yesuho youp amnani inogoc, “Non wönggon Yudia gurocin ongona” ihoroc inogoc.
Tuna youp amnaniho kombiuya angit maidina inogung, “Fandat fandat amna, öngahemgon Yuda nanoho goc sopdec gotgotha togung worocha goc woce ongirocha.”

Ihoroc yuya Yesuho mata tepmo au ingoroc iban imogoc, “Sep youp toctoc danong wömai sepho yaguno möng nimongitac. Tuna amna au yu sep bongonodec uyap itongitacma yu wömai acacho ogepgon itongmuna mamöngitac.
Wohong amna au yu kumbong-nodec yagunono muno uyap itongitacma yu wömai möantac.”
Yesu yu ihoroc yongo wönggon mata sakaun fiuna youp amnani inogoc, “Oröcnoni Lasarus yu komanang dungo itac mahong nocho yuot ongmaina ta wekangoc.”
Yesuhon youp amnaniho mata woroc kombingga inogung, “Moröma, yui dungga idinai wömai obukocno bödeuna orokontac.”
Youp amnani yu wömai kombigung, Lasarus komanang dungga idina yoc mahong Yesu yu Lasarus kömbaha ombocmaha yogoc.
Worocha tongga Yesuho tuctugo inogoc, “Lasarus yu boinno omboc
mahong ‘sontha’ yongo nocho yu ombocan yuot maidot. Ihoroc wömai sonu kombinahing yu boinno sinom omboc. Tuna sonu noc kombing tobing namonahing. Oro urop yuot ongona.”

Ihoroc yuna, amna au mano Tomas yu youp amna nucni inogoc, “Non ambaracho Yesuot ongmanaina kondong omong fatnahamon,” ihoroc yogoc. Oro Tomashon mano au wömai nonin matadec ‘bambam bacbacyi’ ihoroc yongidung.
Yesuho yan dano irot tong koing mata inogoc
Yesuot youp amnaniot yu ongga Betani böc ambehecgon öngkungmuya Yesu mata ingoroc kombigoc: Lasarus yu omongga urop sep youp toctoc awanomuno kumkumon itac.
Betani böc woi Yerusalem ambehecgon idoc. Woi 3 kilomitahon toroc ihoroc.
Worocha tongga Yuda nano koböcmaho engmuya Marta orin Mariahon natno ombocma worochon singguyano ito itfat yugung.
Oro Marta yu kombigoc, Yesu urop ehantac. Ihoroc kombingga karupgon ongga Yesu uyapdec aun fedoc. Maria wömai bucin idoc.
Martaho Yesu aun feuna inogoc, “Moröma, gocho nonot idiyai wömai natnodi mamong faun.
Wohong nocho boinno sinom kombihat, gocho önga yapmu auha Kopotoroc dönac iniyai wömai yuho kombing gamontac.”
Yuna Yesuho inogoc, “Boinno sinom, nada wönggon idongontac.”
Ihoroc yuna Martaho inogoc, “Nocu kombihat, yu wömai mit bongono morömadec wekangoc. Bongono wocin wömai owi amna ambaracho wekongbödenahing.”

Ihoroc yuna Yesuho inogoc, “Omocdecma wekoc wekoc worochon Morömo woi noc naka. O itonggongon Morömo woi ihorocgon noc nakagon. Owi amnaho noc kombing tobing namongidangma yu omnahing mahong mit itonggong koing au feangoc.
Boinno sinom, owi amnaho wec itmuya noc kombing tobing namonahingma yu ambaracho omong koing mau feic. Gocu mata wo kombing tobiharocha woha muno?”
Ihoroc yuna Martaho inogoc, “Öc Moröma, noc kombing tobing gampat. Goc Kopotorochon Manano Duic. Kopotorocho goc owi inoin amnani fogit fogitha ganong muuna gurocdec eboroc.”
Oro Marta yu ihoroc yongo mit ongga dano Maria inong yuna ehuna inong masang tongo yogoc, “Fandat fandat amnaho urop epac. Yu gocha yac.”
Maria yu woroc kombingga wohogon idongga Yesu acacha domdomgon onggoc.
Onguna Yesu yu abe Betani bucin maeboc. Yu osuc Martaho aun fedocan wocingon torengga idoc.
Oro Yuda nanoho Maria itfat yuya yuho bucin idungma yu agungmai Maria yu karupgon idongga taitdec ohogoc. Tuna angga Yuda nano ‘yu yong oin toctocha kumkumon ongeyac’ yongo yu tan tonggung.
Tan tuya Maria yu Yesu aun feuna orungo forodec göruc yemoc tong imongga inogoc, “Moröma, gocho nonot idiyai wömai nochon natna mamong faun.”
Ihoroc yuna Yesuho yagocmai Maria orin Yuda nano yuot ebungma yu ambarac yong ointongo idung. Ihoroc yangmuna yu irot mep tongo uroc imocno sinom tongmuna inogoc,
“Son Lasarus sa nahenne oring sigung?” Ihoroc inuna owi amnaho inogung, “Moröma, goc engmina ahi.”
Ihoroc yuya Yesu yu ihorocgon oin tongga idina
Yuda nanoho yu angmuya yogung, “Aarut, yu amna worocha toup sinom kombingidoc.”
Ihoroc yogung mahong auho wömai yogung, “Yu osuc amna dan komnima tun orokogoc. Yu yaha Lasarus matongfat yegoc! Tongfat yeunahai wömai mamun.”
Yesuho Lasarus tun wekogoc
Oro Yesu yu irot mep sinom tongmuna ongga kumkumondec ongkuboc. Kumkumon woi amnaho sop ganango au tobiuya idoc. Böngo wömai sop moröma au foctongo siuya idoc.

Ihoroc idina angga Yesuho inogoc, “Sop wo öcangmu ongoun.” Ihoroc inuna amna ombocmahon natno Marta yu soroc yongo inogoc, “Moröma, ep fambangno urop sep youp toctoc awanomuno ihoroc kumkumon itac. Worocha tongga tugo wöntucmuno öantac.”
Ihoroc inuna Yesuho inogoc, “Nocho urop ganongdet. Goc kombing tobingminai wömai Kopotorochon gesö moröma aantaroc.”
Ihoroc inuna amna auho sop wo öcangmu onggoc. Tuya Yesuho momdec foringmun uuna dönac yongo yogoc, “Nandöngna, gocu nochon dönac urop kombing namparoc, worocha nocho ecec gantat.

Noc kombihat, goc bongono muno dönacna kombingitaroc mahong ‘owi amna ngocin idangma yu dönacna ngo kombiarut’ yongo eran gantat. Ihoroc toya yuho kombiantang, gocho boinno sinom noc nanongmuya ebot. Ihoroc woroc kombing tobiarut yongo dönac ngo gantat.”
Yesu yu dönac ihoroc yun bödeuna ecnang mamboda yogoc, “Lasarus, goc idongga sumonon epi!”

Ihoroc inuna Lasarus yu idongga sumonon eboc. Orungohu oburohu yangamohu wo boru tombarac sumon eboc. Ehuna Yesuho owi amna inogoc, “Son omomphon boru wo asan imuya ongoun,” Yesu yu ihoroc tuna Lasarusho wekongga idonggoc.
Amna dugoho Yesu wot omom toctochon mata yong torop yongo sigung
Oro Yuda nano koböcma Mariaot ebungma yu Yesuho toroc kiap inobarac togocma wo angmuya kombing tobing imogung.
Wohong auho wömai Farisiot ongmuya Yesuho kiap togocma worochon fatno inogung.

Inuya Farisi orin öret socsochon amna dugo yu Yuda nanohon amna moröma inong yuya engsuran togung. Tongo ingoroc yogung, “Amna woroc yu toroc kiap inobarac koböcma sinom tongitac. Worocha nonu tingting tontamon?

Nontho yu angbananaya suraro ambaracho yu kombing tobing imoningyit. Ihoroc tuyai wömai Röm nanohon tawa amnaho engmuya öret socsoc böc nonihu tu mointuna mepmo moröma sinom nimuya nontho yuhon youp wabkaracni itnam.”

Oro amna dugo yu ihoroc yong tongga itmuya amna au mano Kaiyafas yu idonggoc. Yu wömai biruc worochon öret socsoc böchon amnahon dugo morömano idoc. Tongo yu idongga yogoc, “Sonu kombic kombic soni maec yo.
Kombiarut, kiap tunguhogon wömai non tongfat neangoc. Amna tunguhogon suraro ambarachon abam sogida ompun. Omentacanu wömai non Yuda nano ambaracho magorong ongonin.”

Kaiyafasho mata wo yogocma woi inoin kombic kombicdecma mayogoc. Muno, yu biruc worochon öret socsoc böchon amna dugo idocmaha tongga yu yong tuctuc mata ingoroc yogoc, Yesu yu Yuda nano tongfat yecyecha omengoc.
O Yuda nanohagon muno, yu omengocmaha tongga Kopotorocho weni manani woce woce sa korungon idangma yu ambarac fengsuran tuna torop tungu itnahing.
Oro bongono wocin forosingga Yuda nanohon amna morömaho Yesu wuya omomphon mata yong torop yongo sigung.
Worocha tongga Yesu yu wönggon Yuda nanohon bonipnodec eran maitongidoc. Muno yu youp amnani yangauna böcsa au mano Efraim woce idung. Böcsa wo wömai sa amna maiyan woroc tan idoc.

Oro Israel nanohon bongono morö ‘Pasowa’ yongidangma worocho urop eng fom togoc. Worocha tongga böc wohon wohonma owi amna koböcma yu Yerusalem ögung. Yu wömai ‘wöntucmuno noni tong sac tongga Kopotorocho yangamin sacsago itna’ yongo Yerusalem öngmuya bongono morömaha tong arangarang togung.

Yerusalem öngmuya yu Yesuha yabiu matuna öret socsoc böchon gombo ganang öngmuya mata ingoroc inun ganun tongga yogung, “Son tingting kombiang oro, Yesu yu yong moröng bongono acacha ehantacha woha muno?”

Ihoroc yong tongga idiya öret socsoc böchon amna moröma orin Farisi yu ‘Yesu sogit akep tona’ yongo nongoru ingoroc suraro imogung, Numariho Yesu nahe itacno wo kombinggai yu muyu worochon yongburoc mata amna moröma inarut.
